_purpose: Single source of truth for the Debian/Ubuntu apt packages tools/build_linux_release.sh
installs for the Flutter Linux desktop release build, and the verdict each earns.
The release producer used to run `apt-get install -y <pkg> ...` with no version
pins, so the Linux release binary was built against whatever the distro served that
day. Supply-chain finding S4 (spk_supply 2026-08-10). Each package is classified:
pin  - version drift changes the SHIPPED artifact (link-time ABI or the binary
bytes themselves); the exact version is enforced and verified against.
keep - needed on the build host but version drift cannot change the shipped
artifact (orchestration, download, extraction, or runtime-only tools);
installed unpinned.
drop - not needed, and not installed.
Versions below were measured (dpkg-query) inside the pinned release builder image
winsec-linux-builder:flutter-3.44.6 (Debian GNU/Linux 12 bookworm, linux/amd64),
which is the isolated VM the Linux release is produced in. They are the reference
for that distribution. A different OS must be added here deliberately before a
release is produced on it; tools/verify_linux_apt_pins.py refuses an unrecorded
one (fail-closed).
KNOWN-GAP, DELIBERATE: Ubuntu 24.04 is NOT recorded. GitHub Actions is
not the Linux signing contract. Local/offline producers verify against this
pin set. A GitHub workflow, if used, is one optional OIDC signer and must
not rebuild on an unrecorded distro. The one Linux host that genuinely
produces the archive is the Debian 12 builder image above, so that
is the distribution pinned. If a WSL/Linux machine with unrecorded /etc/os-release
ever becomes a real producer, verify_linux_apt_pins.py will refuse it with a
specific message -- record that distro here (measured versions, same keep/pin/drop
verdicts) and re-run, rather than building unpinned.

debian-12.note: Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm), the base of winsec-linux-builder:flutter-3.44.6.

_pin_reasons.clang: The C++ compiler that emits wins_vpn and winsvpn-bypass-bpf machine code. A different clang emits different shipped bytes.
_pin_reasons.binutils: objcopy/strip/readelf rewrite the shipped binaries in-build: strip --strip-unneeded, objcopy --add-gnu-debuglink, readelf-gated build-id checks. Version drift changes the delivered ELF bytes.
_pin_reasons.libgtk-3-dev: wins_vpn and the bundled engine link libgtk-3.so.0 (measured DT_NEEDED); the dev headers/symlinks determine the ABI surface baked into the shipped binary.
_pin_reasons.libsecret-1-dev: linux/runner links PkgConfig::LIBSECRET (ninja/l GLib secret-store uses secret_password_* sync, measured in linux_secure_store.cc); the dev package fixes the libsecret ABI the shipped binary references.

_keep_reasons.cmake: Build orchestration only; version drift does not change shipped bytes for the fixed CMakeLists.
_keep_reasons.pkg-config: Dependency resolution; resolves the pinned dev packages.
_keep_reasons.curl: Downloads pinned, sha256-verified artifacts (Xray, AmneziaWG, Go SDK); artifact integrity is enforced by hash, not by curl version.
_keep_reasons.git: Release-source integrity checks (git ls-files) and toolchain checkout.
_keep_reasons.tar: Extracts the pinned Go SDK archive.
_keep_reasons.xz-utils: Extraction/compression utility; no shipped ELF links liblzma (measured: zero liblzma in any shipped DT_NEEDED).
_keep_reasons.make: Orchestrates the linux-arm64 amneziawg-tools source build (tools/build_linux_arm64_awg.sh). Version drift does not change shipped bytes for a fixed Makefile plus the pinned awg output hash.
_keep_reasons.libc6-dev: Headers/libs for the linux-arm64 awg compile. Output integrity is the pinned AWG_BINARY_SHA256_ARM64; a header drift that changes bytes fails that hash rather than shipping an unpinned binary.
_keep_reasons.openssl: Test-only: the producer's flutter test step runs tests that shell out to the openssl CLI (for example test/control_plane_pinning_test.dart); it is never invoked to produce or sign release bytes, so it cannot change shipped bytes.

_drop_reasons.liblzma-dev: No shipped artifact links liblzma (measured DT_NEEDED across wins_vpn, libapp.so, libflutter_linux_gtk.so), the Flutter tool has zero lzma references in the Linux build path (measured), and the runner CMake neither includes nor links lzma. Not needed to build the release.
